senses.gloss: f.(b. h. עָבֹת; עָבַת to twist, plait) network, matting; עץ ע׳ a tree screened by a network of foliage. Sifra Emor, Par. 12, ch. XVI (expl.
units: <cite ref="Leviticus 23:40">Lev. XXIII, 40</cite>) <he>את שענף עצו דומה לקליעה</he> the tree the ramification around whose trunk resembles plaiting; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:2:2">Y. Succ. III, 53ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>עץ שענפיו חופין … קליעה</he> a tree the branches of which cover its larger portion and which rises in the shape of a plaiting; Bab.
<cite ref="Sukkah 32b:21">Succ. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>שענפיו חופין את עצו</he> whose branches cover up its trunk.
Ib. היכי דמי ע׳ וכ׳ what is ‘aboth like (when is a tree called ‘aboth)? When three leaves are on each stem.
<cite ref="Sukkah 32b:21">Ib.</cite> <he>ובלבד שתהא עֲבוֹתוֹ קיימת</he> provided its network (three leaves on each stem) remains; a. e.
